name: Permutations & Subsets
description: Generates all permutations or subsets of a given set using recursive backtracking with include/exclude decisions.
aim: Generate all arrangements (permutations) or all subsets of a given array by making recursive choices: include or exclude each element.
howItWorks: For subsets: at each step, decide to include or exclude current element
For permutations: at each position, try all unused elements
Add to result at base case
Backtrack by undoing the last choice

realWorld: All possible configurations in combinatorial search
alternatives: Iterative with next_permutation — O(n) per step

inputHint: The first five values are permuted — n! grows too fast to show more.
